text:
Emma (AE): starting a Zenith Bank migration thread. They're asking for prompt parity, measurable diffs, committed 6mo pricing with burst, and the security questionnaire. I'll capture action items here.
Devin (Solutions): I can run a parity harness. Need their canonical prompt set and current provider samples. Who will own mapping of params?
Kai (Infra Eng): I can provision POC infra + a tiny proxy shim. Two blockers flagged by Zenith: SAML SSO + customer-managed KMS wrap; and an auditable generation log (deterministic IDs).
Priya (Security): security asks: data residency, retention windows, audit log format (parquet preferred), KMS rotation policy. They want the answers by EOD Monday.
Ashley (Platform): note: their current vendor uses `retry_after_ms` on 429. Our runtime can return 503 during scale-up. Suggest we either set a compatibility header `Retry-After` or the proxy returns `retry_after_ms` for them.
sec-bot: created JIRA ZEN-842 and attached the questionnaire.
Devin (Solutions): initial parity run: token-level variance ~12%. Hallucinations on internal product names in ~6 prompts. Proposed normalization: trim + NFKC before tokenization.
Devin (Solutions): sample curl used:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" -d '{"model":"rwd-13b","input":"<ZEN_PROMPT>","max_tokens":200}'
```
Kai (Infra Eng): proxy mapping concept (snippet):
```json
{"map":{"prompt_list":"input","stream":"stream_mode"},"errors":{"503":"retry-after:3","429":"retry_after_ms"}}
```
Emma (AE): Pricing: Zenith expects ~2M reqs/mo. Are retries/partial responses billable? Sales needs a committed 6mo with burst tiers.
Devin (Solutions): quick calc: avg tokens/request=90 -> ~180M tokens/mo. With prefix caching expect 20-30% reduction. I'll produce pessimistic/expected/optimistic cost scenarios.
Ashley (Platform): ops: we can export audit logs to their S3, retention up to 12 months, SOC2 attestation available, EU egress billed separately. For Private deployment (on-prem gateway) we'll add cost+ops note.
Priya (Security): I'll complete questionnaire, attach KMS diagram and rotation window.
Emma (AE): Plan: 1) Devin runs two parity runs and posts diffs, 2) Kai stands up dedicated burst pool + proxy shim, 3) Priya finalizes security responses, 4) Sales drafts 6mo pricing scenarios. Quick sync tomorrow 09:00 PT. Everyone OK?
Kai (Infra Eng): ack, will add smoke header tests.
Devin (Solutions): uploading diffs and flagging top prompt cases to tune.
Emma (AE): looping in legal for DPA/contract redlines. Meeting invite coming. :thumbsup:
